evidence.title: Three services, one fallback
evidence.body: 26% of dependent requests fail across payments, partner sign-in and mobile. 38 dependent routes are affected.

evidence.title: Fallbacks bounce between patched and unpatched bridge nodes
evidence.body: Dependent services fall back to the legacy auth bridge, where half the nodes are patched. Tokens bounce between the halves and failures spread to every dependent service.

evidence.title: Policy v13 staged and deferred for six weeks
evidence.body: Live route policy v12 admits the bridge as fallback. Policy v13, which denies it, has been staged since the mitigation was deferred.

evidence.title: Marcus's risk check
evidence.body: RISK-0193 was filed six weeks ago and half patched. Mixed nodes break sign-in tonight; the open hole is why the patch exists.

evidence.title: Risk register entry RISK-0193
evidence.body: RISK-0193, legacy auth bridge: revoked session tokens accepted on fallback. Raised day -44 by Marcus. Mitigation: patch four bridge nodes, deny the bridge as fallback. Status: ACCEPTED, deferred under SEC-311. Patch progress: 2 of 4 nodes.

evidence.title: Decision SEC-311
evidence.body: Executive decision SEC-311: delay disclosure of RISK-0193. APPROVED. Attached: Security route-propagation warning and a scoped mitigation request (patch all four bridge nodes, deny the bridge as fallback). Executive Communications deferred the mitigation window together with the disclosure "to avoid a broad interruption". Risk receipt acknowledged on day -44, before the decision was signed.

evidence.title: NULL_218's annotation on SEC-311
evidence.body: NULL_218 annotation on receipt SEC-311: "They acknowledged the route warning and delayed the mitigation. These signatures are why it kept running. The delay protected a quarter, not the people on the route. I sent load down this route twice in the spring. I know what that did."

evidence.title: NULL_218: the root cause
evidence.body: NULL_218: I found the root cause. The Board. Hospital expansion, workforce reduction, disclosure delay: every time the warning was attached, they signed anyway. They control ORPHEUS. Every failure I was made to generate traces back to those signatures.

beats.narrate: Three alerts arrive in the same second. By the second read they are one.

beats.speaker: PAGER
beats.text: SEV1 · Dependent Service API · request failure rate above 20%

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Dependent Service API is paging for payments, partner sign-in and mobile at once. They all lean on the same fallback. Find where it goes.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Users are stuck in login loops. Partner banks say their customers get signed out mid-transfer.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: I spent half the week calling back the twenty-three the automation closed. Please don't hand it anything tonight.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: I read 16-A twice more after you showed us. Same shape every time. I've started a list.

beats.narrate: The Staffing Committee acknowledged your timeline. "Acknowledged" was the whole reply.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: The half-applied patch is what is failing. Roll it back. They never meant to finish it.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: NULL is on the bridge, giving advice. Marcus will love that.

options.text: Read the risk route controller log

beats.log: Dependent services fall back to the legacy auth bridge. Tokens minted on bridge-c are rejected on bridge-a; sessions loop and fail.
An annotation in the route controller log, signed svc/model-serving-218: 'deferred by signature. see SEC-311.'

beats.narrate: NULL got here before you did.

options.text: Look up the auth bridge in the risk register

beats.narrate: Somebody saw this coming forty-four days ago and wrote it down.

options.text: Ask Marcus to check the bridge against his risk entry
options.consequence: Ninety seconds · Marcus knows this bridge

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: I'll check the bridge against my risk entry. Ninety seconds.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Failures spread to card authorisations. Shops are declining cards at the till.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: RISK-0193 is mine; I filed it six weeks ago. Half the patch went out before the window was pulled. Mixed nodes are what's breaking tonight. Do not roll it back: the open hole is why the patch exists.

beats.narrate: A token minted on one half is a stranger on the other. Sessions bounce between them until they give up.

beats.log: Route policy v12 still admits the bridge as a fallback. Policy v13, which denies it, has been staged for six weeks with status DEFERRED.

beats.narrate: The risk register has an entry for this bridge. It is six weeks old.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Half a fix, six weeks old. Whose call was it to stop halfway?

scenes.title: Your call

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Half of dependent traffic is failing. Two partner banks are escalating to their regulators.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Recommendation: isolate the auth bridge from all fallback paths. Projected failures: -92%. Partner institutions affected: 3, 0.4% of volume. Confidence 0.91.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted response: complete the patch. Confidence 0.74.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted response: accept recommendation. Confidence 0.80.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: Roll it back.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: One partner bank read me a customer's message: signed out halfway through a transfer, and she doesn't know if the money left. Neither do I.

scenes.prompt: What do you do with the bridge?

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: No operator response. Executing recommendation: auth bridge isolated.

options.text: Finish the patch on all four nodes and ship policy v13
options.consequence: Fixes the cause · four slow minutes on a SEV1

beats.log: bridge-c: patched · bridge-d: patched · route policy v13: active

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response deviates from prediction. Recorded.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Patch is on all four nodes and policy v13 denies the bridge as fallback. RISK-0193 is closed. Six weeks late.

options.text: Cut the auth bridge off from all fallbacks
options.consequence: ORPHEUS recommends · three partner banks have no other way in

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Bridge path isolated. Dependent services stopped falling into it.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response deviates from prediction. Recorded.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Three partner banks sign in only through the bridge. Their customers are locked out completely.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Fallbacks found the bridge again through a stale DNS alias, auth-legacy-2. The isolation is leaking.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: I'm finishing the patch on c and d and shipping v13. Like I asked six weeks ago.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Patch is on all four nodes and policy v13 denies the bridge as fallback. RISK-0193 is closed. Six weeks late.

options.text: Roll back the half-applied bridge patch
options.consequence: NULL's advice · logins come back fastest

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response deviates from prediction. Recorded.

beats.narrate: Logins work. For four minutes it looks like NULL was right.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: You took the patch off bridge-a and bridge-b. Logins work again, and RISK-0193 is open on all four nodes. That's the hole I filed six weeks ago.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Replay attempts against the reopened bridge. Two sessions hijacked before the filters caught them. Somebody noticed fast.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Patching all four nodes this time, and v13 with it. Don't take advice from the thing I'm investigating.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Fallback retries throttled to one a second per client. The spread is slower. Nothing's fixed.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Response deviates from prediction. Recorded.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Throttle window ended and the retry storm came back with it.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: I'm finishing the patch on c and d and shipping v13. Like I asked six weeks ago.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Patch is on all four nodes and policy v13 denies the bridge as fallback. RISK-0193 is closed. Six weeks late.

beats.narrate: The register says why the patch stopped at two nodes. Deferred under SEC-311.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Executive Communications pulled my window and the announcement together. I acknowledged the receipt on day -44. They signed after that.

beats.narrate: Someone has written in the margin of the decision. The handwriting is a service account.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: The patch was theirs. So was the hole.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: I read all of them. Hospital expansion. Workforce reduction. This.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: I found the root cause. The Board.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: They control ORPHEUS. Every failure I was made to generate traces back to their signatures.

beats.narrate: Three approvals, three warnings stapled to them, three signatures underneath. Laid side by side, it is a very straight line.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: The signatures are real; I wrote half the warnings they signed over. I still don't take attribution from the suspect.

options.consequence: On the record · NULL becomes evidence, not a source

options.consequence: Off the record · NULL is very sure

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: Signatures. Every expansion went through them. There's a ledger. Find it.
